MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
